products.title: Wuhansel & Gretel Heavyweight Tee
products.body_html:
Screen printed with pink puff ink on a heavyweight, garment-dyed 100% cotton 7.5 oz blank.

“Wuhansel & Gretel” twists a classic fairytale into a modern cautionary tale; two kids searching for safety, breadcrumbs replaced by face masks, & the woods standing in for the uncertain world we all walked through. The candy house is still there, but the sweetness carries a warning; nothing tempting comes without risk.

Printed oversized on the front in a bold violet single-color process that pops against the garment-dyed heavyweight cement grey, with a back signature hit to finish it clean.

• 7.5oz heavyweight tee; garment-dyed cement grey

• Oversized front illustration + back PJ signature

• Premium print detail with soft hand feel

• PJ original artwork; pandemic-era folklore with bite

For anyone who made it through the woods & knows sometimes survival means rewriting the story.

products.title: New York Hemps Heavyweight Tee
products.body_html:
Beautiful unique pastel orange & blue palette.
New York Hemps reframes the city through a familiar lens: leafy, layered, and unmistakably New York. The design plays with counterculture symbolism & civic identity, merging urban structure with organic forms to create something that feels both relaxed & tightly composed. It’s equal parts satire, statement, & street-level observation.

Printed using a two-color process on a garment-dyed black 7.5oz heavyweight tee, the artwork hits with depth & clarity while staying refined. The limited palette keeps it clean & intentional, letting line work & contrast do the talking instead of noise; bold without shouting.

Built from heavyweight cotton with a durable, soft-hand print, this tee wears like a staple from day one. Structured enough to stand on its own, broken-in enough to feel lived with, it’s the kind of shirt you’d wear walking into Citi Field on a summer night, crowds buzzing, lights coming on, energy thick in the air; comfortable, confident, & exactly where it belongs.

Heavyweight comfort.

Low-key rebellion.

New York, naturally.

products.title: Dollars Heavyweight Tee
products.body_html:
“Dollars” turns Benjamin Franklin into a modern myth; beaming down currency like sunlight. Equal parts optimism and satire, the piece plays with America’s favorite symbol of success, asking whether money guides us… or blinds us.

Minimal by design, the graphic hits with clarity & confidence: bold script, radiant lines, & Franklin floating somewhere between patron saint and warning sign.

Printed front & back in a crisp single-color process on a premium heavyweight tee that feels substantial without sacrificing comfort.

 Details-

  • 7.5oz heavyweight cotton tee, garment-dyed natural
  • Soft hand feel with durable print
  • Front statement graphic + smaller back hit
  • PJ original artwork, clean, iconic, & ironic

products.title: Singin' in the Acid Rain Heavyweight Tee limited edition
products.body_html:
“Singin’ in the Acid Rain” reimagines Gene Kelly dancing through a sleepless NYC downpour; every raindrop glowing like it carries the secrets of the city. Superior footwork meets surreal weather.

Executed in an 8-color print process with expert precision, this design delivers rich contrast & motion while maintaining a soft hand feel.

• 7.5oz heavyweight tee; garment-dyed black

• Premium print detail & durability

Built to last; like the city that inspired it.

This piece captures a very New York moment; standing just outside the 23rd Street Flatiron station, in pouring rain, city noise blurring into rhythm, & still choosing to sing. Singing in the Acid Rain is a twisted love letter to classic optimism; filtered through modern grit, pollution, & the beautiful mesh of the city.

products.body_html:

From the roaring crowd to the ringing bells, the hype is half the fight. products.title: New York Fuckery Heavyweight Tee
products.body_html:
New York Fuckery takes the city’s chaos & stamps it into a cement grey garment dye seal you can wear; a parody of officialdom that got a little too real. The original drop sparked legal threats from the New York State Gaming Commission, who claimed the mark “diluted their well-known brand.”

A local attorney pushed back first, but things shifted when Covington & Burling, a global firm specializing in First Amendment protection; stepped in. Their position was simple:

this design is parody protected as free speech; from the MetroCard typography, to the “No trains, take the L” service-change graphics, to the subway car that always seems off-schedule, & of course… the word “Fuckery.”

After that response?

Silence.

Consider it a David vs. Goliath moment. New York style.

To honor the win, every New York Fuckery tee ships with an extra gift inside.

Wear it like a badge of honor, & a metaphorical middle finger to institutional bullying.

• 7.5oz heavyweight tee; garment-dyed cement grey

• Front hit + full back graphic in tonal black

• Premium print detail with a soft hand feel

• PJ original artwork; parody, resilience, & NYC attitude

products.title: A-Bombshell Heavyweight Tee
products.body_html:
A-Bombshell captures a split second where elegance meets force. A iconic figure mid-twirl becomes a mushroom cloud; movement frozen at the exact moment beauty turns explosive. The linework stays delicate while the idea hits heavy; grace, power, & consequence sharing the same silhouette.

Printed large on the back of a black heavyweight tee, the artwork feels textured against the fabric with subtle puff paint. The puff gives the tee a slightly bumpy feel to it. 

This piece isn’t about shock value; it’s about control. The calm confidence of standing centered when everything else is volatile.

Built on a premium heavyweight cotton tee with a structured drape & durable print, it’s made to wear like a staple while carrying a message that lingers.

Details-

• Heavyweight cotton tee with structured, premium hand feel

• Full back A-Bombshell illustration with fine-line detail, PJ signature on chest

• Durable print designed to age cleanly over time

• Classic fit built for everyday wear

• PJ original artwork; beauty, power, & impact in balance

products.title: The Illest Heavyweight Tee
products.body_html:
The Illest captures a moment of triumph at its most human. Two champions locked in a quiet embrace—victory secured, weight lifted, history settled. It’s not the celebration after the noise, but the second when everything finally makes sense.

Rendered in bold, graphic linework, the piece blends poster-era bravado with raw emotion—strength, relief, & mutual respect distilled into a single frame. Red uniforms cut sharply against white space, letting the bond between the figures carry the meaning.

Printed large on the front of a white heavyweight tee, the composition keeps the focus on form, feeling, and legend; nothing extra, nothing wasted.

  • 7.5oz heavyweight cotton tee: classic white
  • Front-facing illustration with high-contrast detail
  • Durable print with a soft, worn-in hand feel
  • PJ original artwork; pressure, brotherhood, and earned greatness

products.title: New York City Arteries Heavyweight Long Sleeved Tee
products.body_html:
New York City Arteries is a best-selling, thought-provoking design by PJ O’Rourke that reimagines the NYC Subway Map as a human heart. The five boroughs become chambers; subway lines transform into veins & arteries; mapping the city’s lifeblood in a single image.

Inspired by years spent moving, creating, & surviving underground, the piece reflects PJ’s deep connection to the MTA. Early in his career, he sold art at the Union Square subway station; it was there that this design first took shape. What’s usually a map becomes something intimate & vital; a heartbeat you recognize if you’ve ever lived below street level.

Printed front & back in crisp single-color linework, the graphic reads like an X-ray of the city’s circulation. Worn at Queensboro Plaza on a windy day; trains rattling overhead, platforms buzzing, & the river air cutting through; the piece feels exactly where it belongs.

This isn’t decoration.

It’s infrastructure you wear.

Details-

  • 7.5 oz heavyweight tee; garment-dyed black 100% cotton
  • Soft hand print with high detail
  • Premium fit & feel with lived-in comfort
  • PJ original artwork; mapped from real subway lines

products.title: Layer Cake of NY Heavyweight Tees
products.body_html:
A top-three bestseller & a more recent release (December 2024), Layer Cake of New York is PJ’s layered tribute to his journey; from selling art in the subway to running a storefront across from Union Square Park. The concept was sparked by his girlfriend Jillian, who suggested a “Layer Cake” as a metaphor for showcasing life beneath the surface.

Each illustrated layer reveals a piece of New York; the East River’s giant squid nodding to 20,000 Leagues Under NYC, the MTA subway with PJ selling prints from his mobile cart, pizza & infrastructure stacked above, & a surreal underground world of rats, alligators, & a ninja turtle. The skyline crowns it all; featuring the Chrysler Building (PJ’s favorite), the Empire State, & the Woolworth; while the missing slice lives on the chest.

Printed front & back in a single-color, architectural line style, this 7.5 oz heavyweight cement grey option delivers a clean, structured feel with everyday wearability.

Move here & get your slice; or get eaten alive.

Details-

  • 7.5 oz heavyweight tee; garment-dyed cement grey gives it a beautiful depth
  • Premium print clarity with a soft hand feel
  • Front pocket-style graphic + full back illustration
  • PJ original artwork

 

For anyone who knows New York isn’t just a city; it’s a multilayered masterpiece.

products.title: Brooklyn Cassettes Heavyweight Tee
products.body_html:
Brooklyn Cassettes is a love letter to rewind culture; when music lived in your pockets, mixtapes meant something, & the city provided the soundtrack. The graphic pulls from analog-era energy & Brooklyn grit, turning cassette tapes into a visual time capsule; lo-fi, personal, & unapologetically real.

Printed on a 7.5oz 100% cotton heavyweight garment-dyed black tee, this piece carries weight both literally & culturally. The full back illustration hits with fine-line detail & a durable, soft-hand print that feels broken-in from day one; like a favorite tape that survived years of rewinds, fast-forwards, & being left on the dashboard.

It’s the kind of tee you’re wearing when you step onto a train at Jay St / MetroTech & immediately realize it smells wrong, but it’s only one stop, so you power through. Brooklyn logic. Brooklyn resilience.

products.title: New York Hemps Heavyweight Tee
products.body_html:
A calm palette with a mischievous pulse.

This tee pairs pastel orange and soft blue against a rich olive garment-dyed base, creating a color story that feels both nostalgic and quietly electric. It’s the kind of shirt that doesn’t shout & gets noticed by bloodshot eyes.

Mr. Hemps is your friendly neighborhood dealer of good vibes. He delivers the hits in exchange for a smile; nothing aggressive, nothing rushed. Just a smooth transaction between art, color, and mood. Equal parts charm and character, he lives comfortably between humor and design.

The garment dye process gives the olive base a lived-in depth, letting the pastel inks sit naturally on the fabric, softening with wear while keeping the graphic crisp and expressive.

A beautiful shirt for the unique eye.

Easygoing. Considered. Slightly baked. 

Details-

  • 6.5 oz./yd²., 100% ring-spun cotton (18 singles)
  • Garment-dyed olive for rich, washed depth
  • Pastel orange & blue screen print
  • Cotton thread for optimal dye absorption
  • Relaxed fit with semi-dropped shoulder
  • 7/8” ribbed neckband with double-needle top stitching
  • Side-seamed construction
